name: acryl-page
description: The page of a framework-hosted app: our own minimal index (the ACRYL frame's document, not DSH's), its index taps applied per request, and the built client assets the client runtime boots from. Ours, served by acryl-web-server on the framework's node server.
mount: mount it after acryl-web-server and the client rows: it serves '/' and '/assets/*' and applies the webServer index taps (the client modules' __DSH_BOOT__ and registration scripts) to its own document
